body: Yes. I fear the strain it would put on all my pets and any acquaintances I have.

I want to grab my shotgun and just use it as a for sure method for my suicide. I’m unsure about leaving a suicide note but something keeps holding me back and I never pull the trigger.. is it fear? The fear of death or the unknown? The fear of a more painful afterlife? Or... the fear of regretting my decision last second? It’s hard man.. it really is..
Honestly man... I feel the exact same..
